nodes.description: Public uint8 state variable holding the maximum number of whitelisted addresses allowed.
Public mapping(address => bool) recording which addresses are whitelisted.
Public uint8 counter tracking how many addresses have been whitelisted so far.
Constructor that sets maxWhitelistedAddresses from the deployment argument.
Public function allowing the caller to whitelist itself when the limit is not reached.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used as the whitelist key.
State write whitelistedAddresses[msg.sender] = true executed on caller-controlled input.
State counter update numAddressesWhitelisted += 1 performed inside addAddressToWhitelist.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _maxWhitelistedAddresses is assigned to the state variable maxWhitelistedAddresses.
Execution of the constructor writes the maxWhitelistedAddresses state variable.
msg.sender is the untrusted caller that invokes the public addAddressToWhitelist function.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key in the state write whitelistedAddresses[msg.sender] = true.
msg.sender is used to index whitelistedAddresses when checking if the caller is already whitelisted.
The whitelistedAddresses mapping is read in the require check guarding the write in addAddressToWhitelist.
The unsafe write mutates the whitelistedAddresses mapping state variable.
numAddressesWhitelisted is read as the operand of the increment operation.
The increment operation writes the new value back to numAddressesWhitelisted.
maxWhitelistedAddresses is the bound checked by require(numAddressesWhitelisted < maxWhitelistedAddresses) before the counter increment.
maxWhitelistedAddresses acts as a guard limiting the state changes performed by addAddressToWhitelist.
The whitelistedAddresses mapping check guards execution flow of addAddressToWhitelist.
addAddressToWhitelist contains and executes the whitelistedAddresses[msg.sender] = true state write.
addAddressToWhitelist contains and executes the numAddressesWhitelisted += 1 counter update.
